title: Every limit inverse-image section is represented by a stage section.
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. On each $F(j)$ let $P_j$ be a precoverage with singleton isomorphism covers, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and pullbacks along covering arrows [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume each covering presieve has finitely many distinct arrows. Assume transition functors preserve covering presieves and covering pullbacks, are continuous for the generated topologies, and their set-valued inverse-image functors preserve finite limits. Let $V$ be a cocone such that its object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. On $C=V.pt$ let $Q$ be a precoverage with singleton isomorphism covers, stability under finite composition and finite base change, and covering pullbacks. Assume its covering presieves are exactly the transported images of stage covering presieves, and every $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$, a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and $U\in F(i)$. Set $G_t=F(t.hom)_sG$ and $S_t=G_t(F(t.hom)U)$ for $t=(i\to j)$ in $\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and set $H=V_{i,s}G$, $T=H(V_iU)$. Suppose $\alpha_t:G_t\to V_j^sH$ is a family of sheaf maps whose composites with the stage unit at every $X\in F(i)$ equal the limit unit at $X$ in the arrow category. Let $D:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{Set}$ be a diagram, $E_t:D(t)\cong S_t$ isomorphisms, $K$ a cocone on $D$, and $e:K.pt\cong T$ an isomorphism. Assume $eK_t=\alpha_tE_t$ as arrow-category objects for every $t$. Then for every $x\in K.pt$ there exist $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $y\in D(t)$ with $x=K_t(y)$. No transition equation or eventual-equality conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Apply stage-image refinement to e.hom x. Transfer the resulting section z through E_t.inv. Apply hι to that element; Arrow equality gives equality of evaluations up to HEq. The inverse-hom law for E_t and the refinement equality identify e.hom(K_t(E_t.inv z)) with e.hom x. Injectivity of e.hom yields the required equality.

theorem colimit_site_set_section_representatives
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck)]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ Type u)
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (K : Cocone D)
    (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hι : ∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))):
    ∀ x : K.pt, ∃ (t : Under i) (y : D.obj t), x = K.ι.app t y
